scope: Prospective response to the September 15 review; repository declaration, not external preregistration.
historical_correction: Existing breadth-controls and breadth-extension runners read canonical full-history datasets although their earlier design prose called D current-only. D is a rendering style, not a history filter. Preserve those outputs as full-history results.

current_only_factorial.datasets: Existing prompt-distribution-current-only Seen/Unseen datasets, verified to have exactly one history entry per record
cells: one stochastic draw from each of three Answer checkpoints
current_only_factorial.engine: vLLM for every new cell, identical base and quantization
current_only_factorial.evaluation: Canonical cached baseline; generated candidates executed with 2.5 second testcase timeout; unrestricted execution selector, no TED eligibility gate
endpoints: all paired contrasts against greedy one and stochastic three
amortized generation seconds and candidate execution seconds reported separately
current_only_factorial.selection: Report every cell on both splits without selecting a temperature, checkpoint or seed from test results

paired_java_replication.dataset: Existing TIKTOC CodeWorkout student-disjoint train/validation/test split
paired_java_replication.matching: Exact problem, user, current submission and code; require divergent Progress/Answer targets; current-only inputs
paired_java_replication.models: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct; QLoRA Progress and Answer with seeds 2027, 2028, 2029; same hyperparameters as Python paired-target experiment
paired_java_replication.primary: Three-seed unrestricted Progress minus Answer RR with student and exercise cluster intervals
paired_java_replication.secondary: Token and non-empty-line retention on joint repairs; do not apply Python AST TED to Java
paired_java_replication.gate: Verify nonempty matched train/validation, exact source equality, no user overlap across splits, token-limit compliance, and Java reference harness before training
